On G_n the two constant modes have eigenvalues n alpha+2(beta+gamma) and n alpha; for each k=1..n−1 the 2×2 Hermitian Fourier block has eigenvalues b±|beta+gamma exp(2πika/n)|, b=beta+gamma. The zero count of n|ka is gcd(a,n)−1, including even n and gcd>1. For coprime a the minimum is 2−2cos(pi/n), maximum n+4 at unit weights. With A=n alpha, optimal A=delta=b−sqrt(b²−4beta gamma sin²(pi/n)), uniquely maximized delta at beta=gamma, proving the one-parameter optimal ratios and n vs n^(3/2) growth. Independently constructed all distinct coset-incidence matrices and numerical SVD for n=3..10, every a, and verified ranks and exact condition-number formula. Full all-n proof is symbolic Fourier analysis; finite SVD corroborates only tested cases.
